🌟 Pythia | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide agents and users with a comprehensive, real-time, and predictive understanding of global events and their potential future trajectories, all processed locally without ongoing costs.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time global intelligence feeds (news, conflict, weather, cyber, markets, etc.) • 24-hour, weekly, monthly, and yearly forecasts • Runs entirely on local hardware (no cloud dependencies)
📖 Summary: Pythia is a local, cost-free API that provides real-time global intelligence and future forecasts by fusing live world feeds with a swarm-intelligence prediction engine. It runs entirely on user hardware, offering a unified, machine-readable view of global events and their potential outcomes for agents and decision-making.
